answer: The strongest lever is simple: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because terrace only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, velvet is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any ledge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
